claims.detail: Committed exemplar: marketing site and API share Front Door plus WAF before App Service origins with slot-based deployment.

findings.description: HTTPS terminates at Azure Front Door and Application Insights dependency maps cover outbound SQL and HTTP calls.
findings.recommendation: Reconfirm origin certificate pinning after each WAF policy change.

findings.description: Secrets for connection strings reference Key Vault with no plaintext credentials checked into the repository.
findings.recommendation: Enable automatic rotation alerts for any emergency break-glass secrets.
